heads.t: 她鎖定黃仁勳竊AI機密！紐時：華裔女黃樂是中國國安部間諜 紐時報導根據美媒最新揭露的情報備忘錄，華裔女企業家黃樂（Alice Huang）已被美方證實為中國最高情報機構「國家安全部（MSS）」的間諜，鎖定輝達（Nvidia）執行長黃仁勳進行情報蒐集與滲透，意圖獲取先進AI晶片機密並影響出口政策。此案引發華府高度震驚，美國眾議院三大委員會已要求黃仁勳本月出席閉門聽證會說明。 20 分鐘前｜國際 她鎖定黃仁勳竊AI機密！紐時：華裔女黃樂是中國國安部間諜 20 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: She's locking down Yellow In-hoon's A.I. According to recent information memos from the American media, Alice Huaang, a Chinese businesswoman, has been certified by the US as a spy of the Chinese highest intelligence agency, the Ministry of National Security (MSS), which has locked Nvidia’s executive director, Huang Inho, in an effort to obtain first-hand access to the ACCS and influence export policy. The case has caused a great shock in Washington, D.C. The three United States House committees have asked In Ho to attend the closing hearing this month. 20 minutes ago, she locked down the Ai secret!

heads.t: 《不良笑花》藤岡靛疑遭洋男下藥！帶回家看謎片他開始色色⋯逃亡太驚險 日本男星藤岡靛（ディーン・フジオカ）過去曾在台灣發展，代表作為台劇《不良笑花》等，近日他登上日本綜藝節目，意外揭露一段驚險往事。他在節目中透露，過去曾因錯過末班電車，在車站等待首班車時，遭一名陌生外國男子邀請到家中作客，沒想到對方竟暗藏不軌意圖，甚至疑似在飲料中下藥，讓他一度頭暈目眩，最後醒來時已經倒在路邊，所幸獲得送報員伸出援手，才平安脫困。 9 分鐘前｜娛樂 《不良笑花》藤岡靛疑遭洋男下藥！帶回家看謎片他開始色色⋯逃亡太驚險 9 分鐘前｜娛樂

heads.en: Bombs threaten to explode! Europe’s dozens of flights, the mainstream media being intimidated, the Prime Minister speaking out. Several flights to and from Lisbon, Rome and Prague were threatened with bombs on 6 days, three of which were eventually escorted by Hungarian fighters. In addition, a number of prominent media outlets, including the Irish Public Broadcasting Agency, RTÉ, were urgently evacuated in response to threats. However, there is currently no concrete evidence of a link between threats against airlines and media organizations. 18 minutes ago, the international bomb threat went off!

heads.t: 新北「偷拍狼」出獄2天又犯案！超市攝錄裙底判1年2月 新北市板橋區全聯福利中日前發生偷拍事件，涉案者為有多項妨害秘密及性騷擾前科的鄒姓男子，鄒男在出獄僅2天後，利用iPhone 15 Pro手機偷拍2名女子裙下，遭發現報警處理。新北地院審理後，依未經同意攝錄他人性影像罪，判鄒男有期徒刑8個月，合併應執行1年2個月，並沒收其作案手機。 7 分鐘前｜社會 新北「偷拍狼」出獄2天又犯案！超市攝錄裙底判1年2月 7 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: New North "Search Wolf" was released for two days and committed a further crime. In February a year, the supermarket court sentenced him to an incident involving a large number of men with a previous history of clandestine and sexual harassment, who had used the iPhone 15 Pro phone to tap two women under their skirts and were found in police custody. Following a trial in the New North Hall, he was sentenced to eight months in prison without consent for the crime of recording other people's sexual images, and to a period of one year and two months in joint custody, without taking his mobile phone. Seven minutes ago, the New North was released from prison for two days and committed a crime! In February of the year, 7 minutes ago.
